nuggets.text: The Black Knights ran for 569 yards against Bryant, and 16 different players got a carry.
Zach Mundell needed only four carries for 105 yards and the first two touchdowns of his Army career.
Quarterback Cale Hellums ran for 18 touchdowns last season, then added two more in the opener against Bryant.
The entire Corps of Cadets stands for the whole game at Michie Stadium.
The Black Knights' mascot is a mule, officially adopted in 1936, though Army's mule tradition dates to 1899.
Dwight D. Eisenhower played football for Army in 1912, decades before becoming president.
The Black Knights won three straight national titles from 1944 to 1946, with back-to-back Heisman winners in 1945 and 1946.
When the Black Knights last hosted USF in 2003, ESPN's College GameDay came to West Point.
The Black Knights opened a renovated Michie Stadium this season with a 59-3 win over Bryant.
Head coach Jeff Monken, in charge at Army since 2014, is a cousin of NFL coach Todd Monken.
